scope: Named lake/reservoir search, full publisher outline fit and nearby gauge / closure / loaded authorized asset evidence. Public basemap and original stream/street indexes unchanged.

geometry.identity: Group only matching nonzero GNIS IDs; without GNIS, retain a separate source-feature identity. Equal names alone never merge different GNIS identities.
geometry.outline: Full un-clipped, un-simplified WGS84 source polygon union by identity; all holes/parts retained. No centroid or dam-point substitution.
geometry.fit: Full padded extent, no small-polygon fixed scale. Overhead 3D (tilt zero), 2D fallback retained. Selection-note space and two animation frames settle layout before navigating.
geometry.nearby: Lake polygons use EPSG:26944 projected horizontal meters with default SDK equation-based datum transform; not survey accuracy. Zero for footprint intersection; holes remain outside. Other source types retain geodetic distances.
geometry.limits: Reference outlines are not current shorelines, water levels, flooding, connectivity or proof of safe access.

localBrowser: Millerton Lake and Pine Flat Reservoir alias searches select full outlines and show nearby evidence.
Selecting Millerton / Friant Dam reporting-site search result selects its associated complete Millerton Lake outline.
Pine Flat 5-mile live vicinity: one configured gauge and seven returned road records, with status / coverage qualifications.
Exercise Millerton 5-mile vicinity: one configured gauge and two fictional assets from a four-site inventory; live roads explicitly disabled. No additional real private account sign-in performed.
At 390x844, phone Map/search and full-outline fit work without horizontal page overflow (390px scroll width).

SDK projection / distance fixture preserves interior, road intersection and island-hole behavior; controlled hole distance 2675.448m versus independent geodetic 2675.586m. This is a units/method integration check, not real-world source accuracy validation.
privacyAndFailure: Queries remain local and are not sent to geocoders or source endpoints. Public geometry shards load only on selection.
Lake-index failure preserves available street/stream search results with a separate visible coverage gap.
Delayed selections and layout phases cancel on navigation / clearing. Existing private sign-out invalidation tests pass.
Private sites must be authorized and loaded; no permissions or AGOL items changed. Missing assets / geometry remain unknown.
